name: Pennies from Heaven
description: Pennies from Heaven is a Hand and Foot Canasta variant. 6 players, 4 packs+8 jokers. Four canasta types: natural(500), mixed(300), wild(1000), sevens(1500). Draw 2 per turn. Must complete one of each canasta type to go out. 13 hand + 11 face-down foot. 20,000 to win.

history.origins: Pennies from Heaven is the name used in card game literature for a distinctive North American variety of Canasta related to Hand and Foot. Almost identical rules appear in the US Playing Card Company's Official Rules of Card Games and in John Scarne's Encyclopedia of Games. Related variants include Railroad Canasta and Bain Hand and Foot (Barbara Bain).
timeline: USPC and Scarne published nearly identical rules; game is in the Hand and Foot canasta family.
history.evolution: Four canasta types; wild and sevens bonuses.

setup.deck: 4 packs, 8 jokers. Twos and jokers wild.
setup.dealing: 13 each + 11 face-down (foot). Top of stock turned for discard.

rules.objective: First team to 20,000. Need one of each: natural(7 same rank, no wild), mixed(â‰¤3 wild), wild(7 wilds), sevens(7 sevens). Complete a canasta to pick up foot.
rules.gameplay: 1. Draw 2 or take discard pile. 2. Meld. 3. Discard. 4. Natural=500, mixed=300, wild=1000, sevens=1500. 5. Sevens cannot discard until both teams have sevens canasta. 6. Red threes: place, draw replacement; 100 each (or -100). 7. Go out: all four canasta types; meld all (or all but one); discard not a seven.
keyRules: Four canasta types required to go out.
Foot: 11 face-down; pick up after completing first canasta.
Sevens: cannot discard until both teams have sevens canasta.

tips: Cannot take pile if top wild or three.
